ddbCorrections.name: Correct D&D Beyond characters after a sync
ddbCorrections.hint: After a ddb-importer sync (and at GM login for any character synced since), re-apply the table's fixes: apparel typed as consumables, 1/day feat spells shown At-Will, item Cast activities that cannot spend charges, the Transmuter's Stone benefits. Items frozen with ddb-importer's "ignore item update" flag are left alone.
